title: Wake 5: A Python Framework for Solidity Testing, Fuzzing, and Static Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.09307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart-contract fuzzers differ by an order of magnitude in throughput and by design in how they construct inputs, yet published comparisons rarely separate the two. We present Wake 5, an open-source Python framework for Solidity testing, fuzzing and static analysis, and use it to locate the binding constraint of stateful smart-contract fuzzing. Wake 5 replaces the JSON-RPC connection to an external node with an in-process EVM (revm) and exposes its static analysis to language-model agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. On the Daedaluzz maze benchmark (153 reachable assertions, guard constants below 2^32), Wake 5 executes 29,931 transactions per second, on par with Foundry (30,186) and 11.5x faster than Echidna (2,600). In eight-hour campaigns, however, the three tools plateau at medians of 75, 71 and 70 assertions, and their union reaches 93. We show that Wake's integer generator places 51% of its probability mass below 2^

translated_title: Wake 5：一个用于Solidity测试、模糊测试与静态分析的Python框架
translated_abstract: 智能合约模糊测试工具在吞吐量上相差一个数量级，且在输入构造方式的设计上也各不相同，然而已发表的对比研究很少将这两者区分开来。我们提出了Wake 5，一个用于Solidity测试、模糊测试和静态分析的开源Python框架，并利用它来定位有状态智能合约模糊测试的关键约束。Wake 5用进程内EVM（revm）取代了与外部节点的JSON-RPC连接，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器将其静态分析能力暴露给大语言模型智能体。在Daedaluzz迷宫基准测试上（153个可达断言，保护常数低于2^32），Wake 5每秒执行29,931笔交易，与Foundry（30,186）持平，比Echidna（2,600）快11.5倍。然而在八小时的测试活动中，三种工具分别停滞在75、71和70个断言的中位数水平，而它们的并集达到93个。我们证明Wake的整数生成器将51%的概率质量分配在低于2^（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Wake 5通过进程内EVM将Solidity模糊测试吞吐量提升至与Foundry持平（每秒约3万笔交易、比Echidna快11.5倍），并据此揭示出当前有状态智能合约模糊测试的真正瓶颈在于输入构造策略而非执行速度。
en_tdlr: Wake 5 achieves Solidity fuzzing throughput on par with Foundry (~30k tx/s, 11.5x faster than Echidna) via an in-process EVM, revealing that input construction—not execution speed—is the binding constraint of stateful smart-contract fuzzing.
